author: mongobongo
quote:
Remember that time when you were younger and even the smallest things felt magical? Kojima is one of the few that still manages to make any of us feel that again.
To the idiots shocked by death stranding 2—you knew exactly what Kojima was cooking, and still act surprised. That’s not confusion, that’s brain rot. Move along morons.
